_comment: Claude-judged preference pilot, step 1 (experiments/chat_general/PLAN.md, preference step; judge_pilot.sh is step 2, at home): candidates on the winner, pk_sft_v1 (C:/ml_artifacts/general_chat/sft, GGUF 4d53c7ff...; Jonathan's pick, 27 Oct 2026), from ember's CUDA server at T 512: 4 replies per prompt (temperatures 0.8/0.9/1.0/0.9, seeds recorded) for the first 200 eligible smol-smoltalk test-split prompts, 128 new tokens (pk_sft_v1 runs past 64 on 88% of chat_prompts_v1's ultrachat prompts, and a cut candidate trains a reply with no end). ember main 7526469: e57c0fb's utf8_valid (cherry-picked as 2fb95b2) on every text path, so /chat answers a reply cut inside a UTF-8 character with U+FFFD where fe01b35 and bace837 answer HTTP 500 (pk-bench2's IF-tiny job died of that); generated ids unchanged (ember experiments/utf8_2026-10-27). aa50a61 (tiny_chat_run.EMBER_COMMIT, ember main of 25 Oct: IR spec v1, the CUDA prefill rmsnorm fix) and fe01b35 are ancestors, and no gate holds sampling to that line: EMBER_GEMM_TF32=0 still selects FP32 GEMMs, EMBER_DETERMINISTIC=1 only adds the exact verify pass under speculation, and with EMBER_SPEC and EMBER_DRAFT unset the decode kernels are 70ed063's unchanged. The server runs with EMBER_GEMM_TF32=0 and EMBER_DETERMINISTIC=1. Replies with U+FFFD: sample_candidates.py's rule trim_cut_tail_drop_other (a length cut inside a character is trimmed to its last whole character; any other U+FFFD drops that run from the candidates). Uploads: pksft.gguf, pksft.safetensors (chat_eval_stage.py stages both), vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf.
